name: automattic/wpcom-legacy-redirector
description: WordPress plugin for handling large volumes of legacy redirects in a scalable manner.

scripts.test:integration: npx wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/WPCOM-Legacy-Redirector ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration-ms: npx wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/WPCOM-Legacy-Redirector /bin/bash -c 'WP_MULTISITE=1 ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist'

scripts-descriptions.cs: Run PHP CodeSniffer to check code style
scripts-descriptions.cbf: Run PHP CodeSniffer to fix code style issues
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Generate a POT file for translation
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHP parallel lint to check for syntax errors
scripts-descriptions.prepare-behat-tests: Prepare the environment for Behat tests
scripts-descriptions.test: Run all tests for the WPCOM Legacy Redirector plugin.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration-ms: Run integration tests in multisite mode via wp-env.
